SELECT NVL(MAX(notice_id), 0) + 1 FROM notices
INSERT INTO notices(notice_id, category, title, content, created_by, created_at, project_id, is_pinned, is_deleted, attachment_group_id) VALUES(#{noticeId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, #{projectId}, #{isPinned}, 'Q2', #{attachmentGroupId})
mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id, n.category, n.title, n.content, n.created_by, n.created_at, n.project_id, n.is_pinned, n.is_deleted, p.project_name, p.start_date, p.end_date, r.role_name, c.code_name AS pinned_name, u.user_name, n.attachment_group_id FROM notices n JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = n.project_id JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = n.category JOIN common_code c ON n.is_pinned = c.code_value JOIN users u ON u.user_id = n.created_by WHERE n.notice_id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT(u.user_name), u.user_id FROM notices n JOIN users u ON n.created_by = u.user_id JOIN projects p ON n.project_id = p.project_id WHERE (p.parent_project_id = #{id} OR n.project_id = #{id} AND u.is_active = 'O1')

SELECT DISTINCT(t.type_name), t.task_type_id FROM notices n JOIN task_types t ON t.task_type_id = n.category JOIN projects p ON n.project_id = p.project_id WHERE (n.project_id = #{id}) AND t.is_active = 'O1'
